$comment: Grandfathered accepted/implemented RFCs whose primary normative artifact is not yet folded into the canonical spec (issue #204). Each MUST cite a follow-up issue tracking the fold, and carry a `disposition` (srs#591, mirroring srs#590's fix to the sibling publication-reachability-exclusions.json): `"permanent"` means the deferral itself was ruled settled for good and `issue` cites the (possibly closed) issue whose ruling made it so; `"pending"` means real fold work remains and `issue` MUST cite a currently-open issue, reclassified or removed once that issue closes over the fold. Allowlisting skips ONLY the integration-completeness check (that every declared manifest token resolves and the manifest is non-empty); status legality, proposal-artifact-path existence, and .md<->record status consistency stay enforced. New accepted RFCs may NOT be added here without review — the gate (scripts/check-rfc-integration.mjs) hard-fails otherwise. Remove an entry once its follow-up lands and the RFC's manifest fully resolves.

042.reason: RFC-042 is Accepted (owner ruling 2026-09-07, "lets flip rfc 42", srs#558) as the concept tree's spine — the tree already exists additively in the corpus (44 concepts, 395 contains / 178 precedes / 90 depends-on edges per Rev 2's re-measurement) and needs no schema or dataModelRevision change. Its canonical folding is the four Wave 3 units: srs#559 (mechanism Type, exposition_role/layer fields, the three relation types), srs#562 (un-baking the 127 markdown headings into records), srs#563 (rewriting the Parts I-IV reading order and re-anchoring Part containers), and srs#564 (inlining invariants with a generated index, retiring RFC-016 [R6]) — none of which has executed yet. Remove this entry when those four units land and the RFC's srs-integration manifest can declare their resulting records/types directly instead of tooling-only.
